title: analytics: a runtimeFilter member through an undeclared dotted path gets three different answers from the native, ObjectQL and preview faces
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28258 dev (PR #28553, os-dev-report `6554100004` on #28258), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: `queryDataset` `runtimeFilter`, measured on all three faces. A member through an undeclared path (`account.name`): native answers `DATASET_INVALID` / 400, ObjectQL answers `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (cross-object filter), and the draft preview answers `[]`. Same family as #28258, on the filter face rather than the dimension face.

Business reason: the same dashboard filter refuses with two different codes depending on the strategy, and the preview shows an empty result instead of a refusal, so neither the console nor an author can rely on one answer.

## Wanted

One answer on all three faces for an undeclared dotted `runtimeFilter` member, chosen the way #28258 chose it for dimensions.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `runtimeFilter dotted` (17 hits): only #28258 (dimension face) and closed precedents. **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the dataset compiler and the draft preview path).

Links back: #28258, PR #28553, #28201 (the preview undeclared-dimension precedent, closed)
